name: AISLING
author: CU_STE
description: A generative Irish ambient instrument: harps in a jig's threes and a flute over a drone, with surf, wind and rain. Eight pieces play themselves for ever; play along on the keys. The FM-1 firmware's engine, native. A fork of NACHTFAHRT (FartyPants), DUB-1 and AMB-1 (Charles Vestal)
